description: This Java test class verifies the interaction between timeout, response-required flag, and requested acknowledgements in the HttpRequestActor component. It uses parameterized tests to cover various input combinations to ensure proper handling of HTTP status codes and behavior.

classes.name: HttpRequestActorHeaderInteractionTest
classes.description: A JUnit parameterized test class that verifies the behavior of HttpRequestActor under different timeout, response-required, acknowledgment request, and success/failure scenarios.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Provides all combinations of the test parameters for the parameterized test.

methods.description: Returns a successful or failed response based on the isSuccess flag.
